description.zh: 劳务报酬个税预扣预缴：税前算税后，税后反推税前
description.en: Labour remuneration withholding tax: gross to net, net to gross

description.zh: 税前算税后、税后反推税前，Enter 复制数字
description.en: Gross to net or net to gross; Enter copies the number

ai.description: Compute Chinese individual income tax withheld on labour remuneration (劳务报酬所得, per-payment prepayment). Input '8000' to convert gross to net, or '税后 6720' to solve gross from net. Rates follow SAT Announcement 2018 No.61 Annex Table 2: 20% up to 20,000 taxable, 30% to 50,000, 40% above, with a 800 yuan deduction for income up to 4,000 and 20% otherwise. Excludes VAT and surcharges. The first item's title holds the answer.
